description:
[Web scraping & KYB verification. Read-only, non-destructive, side-effect free]. Analyzes website tech stacks (CMS, frameworks, e-commerce engines), extracts VAT numbers and legal entities from footers and privacy policies, and verifies them deterministically via VIES & GLEIF.
Usage: Use this tool when starting with a company website URL to discover its tech stack and corporate identity. If you already have an EU VAT number and need direct registry lookup, use 'vies_gleif_kyb_verify' instead.
Returns: JSON object with { url: string, technologies: { cms: string | null, ecommerce: string | null, analytics: string[], frameworks: string[] }, extractedVat: string | null, kybVerification: object | null }.
name: b2b_tech_profiler
